common_name: Pink Splash Arrowhead Plant (Green-and-Pink Splashed Syngonium)

planting.note: Move outdoors to a shaded location after temperatures remain consistently above 60°F; in zone 9 place outdoors April-October and bring indoors before temperatures approach 50°F. Pink Splash bears irregular pink and cream speckling and blotching over green, unlike the solid-pink coloring of cultivars such as Neon Robusta.

directions: Plant in bright indirect light to shade — avoid direct sun, which bleaches the variegated coloring — in well-drained, humus-rich, slightly acidic to neutral, consistently moist potting mix. Pink Splash bears arrowhead-shaped leaves irregularly speckled and blotched with pink and cream over a green background, a mottled variegation pattern distinct from the solid, even pink coloring of cultivars like Neon Robusta. Like other arrowhead plants it is among the most adaptable and genuinely shade-tolerant tropical foliage plants available, thriving in conditions from bright indirect light to fairly deep shade while maintaining good foliage quality. Its compact, bushy juvenile form suits small containers and shaded plantings before it begins to vine and climb with maturity; stem cuttings root easily in water or moist propagating mix for easy multiplication.
